title: Cost Chronicle: inspector + pricing flow explorations for token-attributed timelines
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: design a time-first token-cost inspector ("Cost Chronicle") that surfaces token-level cost breakdowns across sessions and routes, enables rapid attribution to prompts, routes, and model variants, and supports exportable pricing bundles for billing and SKU mapping. Focus is on a timeline-first UI with both dense micro-table and visual summary modes, together with a guided export wizard that maps tokens to pricing tiers. This ticket covers high-fidelity prototypes, interaction patterns, export schema, and accessibility guidance for PM/Eng review.
design_variants: Chronicle timeline: stacked per-route swimlanes with expandable session rows
Ledger view: compact sortable table of token line-items with inline attribution tags
Sankey overlay: route->prompt->model cost flow for high-level attribution
Sparkline mini-cards: per-customer/per-route trend tiles for quick SLO checks
Export wizard: column mapping, SKU bundling, and date-range chunking
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates timeline + ledger toggle and preserves context when drilling from timeline -> ledger
Export CSV spec accepted by Billing and Product (columns documented below) and passes sample export QA
Interactions follow a11y contrast and keyboard navigation rules (details in UX notes)
Design handoff artifacts (Figma frames, redlines, tokens) uploaded and linked in this ticket
PM approves pricing pattern microcopy and default SKU mappings for v1 export
api_export_spec: Recommended CSV columns: timestamp, session_id, route, route_version, prompt_hash, prompt_text_preview, token_count_input, token_count_output, token_cost_usd, model_family, model_variant, quantization, customer_id, workspace_id, billing_sku, price_per_unit_usd, note
Chunking: exports >1M rows must be split by date-window (default 7d) and provided as multi-part zipped CSVs
Privacy: prompt_text_preview capped to first 256 chars and redacts PII by default; full prompt export requires enterprise consent flag
Line-item mapping: include billing_sku and price_per_unit_usd for each row to enable downstream invoicing
ux_notes: Keyboard-first timeline navigation: left/right to scrub time, up/down to change swimlane, enter to expand session details
Color: use semantic cost palette (low->green, medium->amber, high->magenta) and ensure 4.5:1 contrast with background
Tooltips: show cost breakdown and example tokens on hover; rely on aria-describedby for screen readers
Localization: number formatting per locale, currency symbol separate field to avoid RTL layout issues
Microcopy: use "tokens (input)" and "tokens (output)" consistently and avoid "prompt tokens" shorthand
qa_checklist: Verify timeline zoom preserves aggregation buckets and aligns to 1s/10s/1m buckets depending on range
Export sample CSV validated against schema with mocked billing_sku mapping
Ensure keyboard navigation and aria labels for all interactive elements
Confirm prompts are redacted by default in non-enterprise tenants
Cross-browser check: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Electron console wrapper
